fact: The Oxford Institute of Technology and Justice states that The Gambia's parliament introduced a proposed Cybercrime Bill in March 2024 and that, as at June 2026, it has not been enacted.

The Information and Communications Act, 2009 (No. 2 of 2009) entered into force on 29 May 2009 and carries Part III of Chapter III, 'Computer Misuse and Cyber Crime', creating offences such as unauthorised access to computer data (fine of 200,000 dalasis or up to five years' imprisonment, or both).
The Gambia Press Union cited the Cybercrime Bill 2023 as pending legislation with broad surveillance powers, heavy fines and prison terms.
